plans.label: queue-default
plans.sql:
SELECT s.id,s.author_id,s.status,s.target_kind,
   s.expected_revision::text,s.current_revision::text,to_char(s.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS created_at,
   to_char(s.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS updated_at,
   (jsonb_typeof(r.payload->'fields')='array' AND NOT EXISTS
    (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.payload->'fields') f WHERE jsonb_typeof(f->'evidence') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array')) AS evidence_valid,
   (SELECT count(*)::text FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.payload->'fields') f,
    LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(f->'evidence') e) AS evidence_count
   FROM (SELECT s.* FROM "proto_http_8bf8a0fee67c4330aa246e6d91332257".submissions s
   WHERE s.status IN ('submitted','in_review','changes_requested')
    AND ($1::text IS NULL OR s.status::text=$1) AND ($2::text IS NULL OR s.target_kind=$2)
    AND ($3::text IS NULL OR s.id::text=$3 OR strpos(lower(normalize(s.target_kind,NFC)),lower(normalize($3::text,NFC)))>0)
    AND ($4::timestamptz IS NULL OR (s.created_at,s.id)>($4::timestamptz,$5::uuid))
   ORDER BY s.created_at,s.id LIMIT $6) s
   JOIN "proto_http_8bf8a0fee67c4330aa246e6d91332257".submission_revisions r ON r.submission_id=s.id AND r.revision=s.current_revision
   ORDER BY s.created_at,s.id LIMIT $6

plans.label: audit-filtered
plans.sql:
SELECT seq::text,to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS created_at,action,actor_id,target_kind,target_id,target_revision::text,
   before_hash,after_hash,reason,request_id,prev_hash,this_hash,canonical_content
   FROM "proto_http_8bf8a0fee67c4330aa246e6d91332257".audit_events WHERE seq>$1::bigint AND seq<=$2::bigint
    AND ($3::text IS NULL OR action=$3) AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR actor_id=$4)
    AND ($5::uuid IS NULL OR target_id=$5) AND ($6::timestamptz IS NULL OR created_at>=$6)
    AND ($7::timestamptz IS NULL OR created_at<$7)
    AND ($8::text IS NULL OR strpos(lower(normalize(action,NFC)),lower(normalize($8::text,NFC)))>0 OR strpos(lower(normalize(target_id::text,NFC)),lower(normalize($8::text,NFC)))>0 OR strpos(lower(normalize(coalesce(reason,''),NFC)),lower(normalize($8::text,NFC)))>0)
   ORDER BY audit_events.seq LIMIT $9

Plans.Filter: ((action = 'submission.created'::text) AND ((strpos(lower(NORMALIZE(action, NFC)), 'submission'::text) > 0) OR (strpos(lower(NORMALIZE((target_id)::text, NFC)), 'submission'::text) > 0) OR (strpos(lower(NORMALIZE(COALESCE(reason, ''::text), NFC)), 'submission'::text) > 0)))

plans.label: stats-exact
plans.sql:
SELECT
   (SELECT last_seq::text FROM "proto_http_8bf8a0fee67c4330aa246e6d91332257".audit_head WHERE singleton) AS highwater,
   (SELECT count(*)::text FROM "proto_http_8bf8a0fee67c4330aa246e6d91332257".submissions WHERE status IN ('submitted','in_review')) AS pending,
   (SELECT count(*)::text FROM "proto_http_8bf8a0fee67c4330aa246e6d91332257".submissions WHERE status='changes_requested') AS needs_info,
   count(*) FILTER (WHERE action='in_review->approved')::text AS approved,
   count(*) FILTER (WHERE action='in_review->rejected')::text AS rejected
   FROM "proto_http_8bf8a0fee67c4330aa246e6d91332257".audit_events WHERE created_at>=$1::timestamptz AND created_at<$2::timestamptz
    AND seq<=(SELECT last_seq FROM "proto_http_8bf8a0fee67c4330aa246e6d91332257".audit_head WHERE singleton)

Plans.Filter: ((created_at >= '2026-10-23 22:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone) AND (created_at < '2026-10-24 22:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone))
